primary_task: List the files in a given folder matching a pattern and write or update an index/table section of links to them in a target markdown file.

requirements.name: read/list files
requirements.evidence: 2. **Discover**: List all files in the specified folder `${input:folder}` matching pattern `${input:pattern}`
requirements.basis: read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)

requirements.name: edit/write files
requirements.evidence: 5. **Update**: Replace existing section or add new section with file index
requirements.basis: edit existing files and Jupyter notebooks

notes: Entirely local. Optional size/modified metadata is obtainable via shell (ls/stat). No ambiguity affects the verdict.
